name: greeter
description: A minimal, stateless Go HTTP service exposing GET /hello, which returns a JSON greeting for an optional `name` query parameter (falling back to a generic greeting when omitted). It follows the project layout and HTTP conventions in app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference (cmd/<service>/main.go entrypoint, internal/<pkg> for logic, JSON error shape, PORT env var). It does not persist any data, does not authenticate callers, and does not expose any endpoint beyond /hello and a health check.
